scripts.motion:render:runtime: pnpm tokens:build && pnpm --filter @ordivon/studio-motion render:runtime && uv run ordivon-studio normalize-h264-bt709 out/runtime-flow.mp4
scripts.motion:render:replay: pnpm tokens:build && pnpm --filter @ordivon/studio-motion render:replay && uv run ordivon-studio normalize-h264-bt709 out/runtime-request-replay.mp4
scripts.motion:review:replay: uv run ordivon-studio review-video out/runtime-request-replay.mp4 --production-root productions/runtime-introduction --source apps/motion-remotion/src/request-replay-composition.tsx --source apps/motion-remotion/src/runtime-demo-receipt.ts --source productions/runtime-introduction/evidence/runtime-demo.receipt.json --output-dir out/reviews/runtime-request-replay --no-audio
scripts.motion:render:close: pnpm tokens:build && pnpm --filter @ordivon/studio-motion render:close && uv run ordivon-studio normalize-h264-bt709 out/runtime-exact-close.mp4
scripts.motion:qc:runtime: uv run ordivon-studio qc-video out/runtime-flow.mp4 --width 1920 --height 1080 --frame-rate 30/1 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --color-range tv --no-audio
scripts.motion:qc:replay: uv run ordivon-studio qc-video out/runtime-request-replay.mp4 --width 1920 --height 1080 --frame-rate 30/1 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --color-range tv --no-audio
scripts.motion:qc:close: uv run ordivon-studio qc-video out/runtime-exact-close.mp4 --width 1920 --height 1080 --frame-rate 30/1 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --color-range tv --no-audio
scripts.python:test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.check:core: pnpm tokens:build && pnpm models:check && pnpm python:test
scripts.check: pnpm check:core && pnpm typecheck && pnpm preview:build
